history.sg_progress: The Department of Operational Support, in collaboration with the Office of Information and Communications Technology, is working on several enhancements for the updated electronic fuel management system. Among other things, the enhancements will improve reporting from the field concerning fuel consumption and stockholding. The enhancements also include some aspects of the acceptable performance levels. In addition, the improvements will provide field missions with access to various reports that will help them identify and investigate problems and take corrective actions.

history.recommendation_text: The Board recommends that the Administration improve reporting from the field concerning fuel needs and consumption in order to identify situations that require taking appropriate actions as and when needed.
history.administration_response: In alignment with the plan approved by the electronic fuel management system board, on 8 July the Office of Information and Communications Technology released a set of reports on fuel consumption, for example, on the following –⁠ Daily consumption (30 days running average); –⁠ Trend analysis; –⁠ Comparative analysis by period; –⁠ Comparative analysis by location; –⁠ Verification of invoiced volume; –⁠ Cost recovery of volume delivered to other entities; –⁠ eApp (Fuel volume customized for eApp report); –⁠ Analysis of fuel delivered in bulk. Stock reports and the fuel risk dashboard were deployed in September 2024, as planned.
history.board_assessment: The set of reports and analyses provides a good starting point towards the effective implementation of the recommendation.
